title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
title_zh: DeXplicit：在灵巧操作世界模型中使物理状态显式化

paragraphs.en: Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit , a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history. Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27–40 % \% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU + by 47 % \% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57 × \times speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis. Project page: https://dexplicit.github.io .
paragraphs.zh: 在对物体执行操作之前，机器人需要预判其手部运动将如何改变物理世界，以及 resulting 的场景将会是什么样子。 现有方法通常将动作条件下的动力学、相机运动和视觉合成纠缠在同一个视频生成模型中，或者将动力学表示为点轨迹而缺乏显式的物体结构。 我们提出 DeXplicit，一个灵巧操作世界模型，它在渲染视觉后果之前，以度量 3D 的方式显式预测世界如何演化。 给定初始场景和未来手部轨迹，一个轻量级的 3D 动力学网络预测以物体为中心的运动和形变，提供结构化且具有几何依据的未来世界状态。 这些预测随后为视频生成提供了强大的支架：外观通过预测的 3D 运动进行传递并投影到未来视图中，使渲染器能够专注于补全不确定的和新可见的内容，而不是从像素中隐式地学习世界动力学。 这种显式 3D 优先的分解还实现了高效的因果生成，在以已生成历史为条件的情况下，每个块只需两步去噪。 在 HOT3D、OakInk2 和 PhysTwin 上，DeXplicit 相比 PointWorld 将移动点误差降低了 27–40 % \%，并在共享渲染器下将 HOT3D 上的物体保真度 IoU + 提升了 47 % \%。 我们采用两步因果生成的设计，使 14B 双向配置在视频合成中实现了 57 × \times 的加速。 项目主页：https://dexplicit.github.io 。

paragraphs.en: World models for dexterous manipulation increasingly use action-conditioned video generation ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ; Hansen and others, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) to predict the visual consequences of an agent’s actions. However, visual plausibility does not ensure that an object responds correctly to the action or preserves its identity throughout the interaction. This gap is especially important in dexterous manipulation, where small errors in object pose or local geometry can break hand-object contact relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 灵巧操作的世界模型越来越多地使用动作条件视频生成（Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018；Hafner et al., 2023；Hansen and others, 2024；Yang et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2024；Zhu et al., 2024；NVIDIA, 2025）来预测智能体动作的视觉后果。 然而，视觉上的合理性并不能保证物体对动作做出正确响应，也不能保证物体在整个交互过程中保持其同一性。 这一差距在灵巧操作中尤为重要，因为物体位姿或局部几何的微小误差都可能破坏手与物体的接触关系。

paragraphs.en: A key difficulty in using action-conditioned video generation for this task is that pixels entangle the object’s physical evolution only with its visual appearance ( Du and others, 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Goswami et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . A model may synthesize a convincing grasp while placing the object at an incorrect 3D pose, or allow its geometry and surface features to drift through occlusion. These failures reflect the burden of leaving physical state implicit: the generator must learn how hand actions change the object while simultaneously determining how those changes appear under varying viewpoints and occlusion ( Sudhakar et al., 2024 ; Akkerman et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Goswami et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 将动作条件化的视频生成用于该任务的一个关键难点在于，像素将物体的物理演化仅与其视觉外观纠缠在一起（Du and others, 2023；Wu et al., 2023；Guo et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2025；Goswami et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026）。 模型可能在合成出令人信服的抓取动作的同时，将物体置于错误的三维位姿，或使其几何形状和表面特征在遮挡过程中发生漂移。 这些失败反映了将物理状态保持隐式所带来的负担：生成器必须在学习手部动作如何改变物体的同时，还要确定这些变化在不同视角和遮挡条件下如何呈现（Sudhakar et al., 2024；Akkerman et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2025；Goswami et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Metric 3D prediction ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Duisterhof et al., 2026 ; Soraki et al., 2026 ) provides this missing interface by representing the object’s physical evolution as an explicit intermediate state for visual synthesis. PointWorld expresses actions and scene evolution as point trajectories in a shared coordinate system ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , making motion measurable before rendering. However, this generic point trajectory does not explicitly encode the distinct structures of the hand and the manipulated object ( Goswami et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . In physical hand–object interactions, hand joints are linked by a kinematic hierarchy, whereas object points share coherent motion with local changes caused by articulation or deformation. Leaving these relationships implicit ( Sanchez-Gonzalez and others, 2020 ; Pfaff and others, 2021 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) can allow object geometry to distort or drift relative to the interacting hand, compromising both physical prediction and subsequent visual synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 度量式三维预测（Huang 等，2026；Huang 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025；Duisterhof 等，2026；Soraki 等，2026）通过将物体的物理演化表示为显式的中间状态以供视觉合成，提供了这一缺失的接口。 PointWorld 将动作和场景演化表示为共享坐标系中的点轨迹（Huang 等，2026），使运动在渲染之前即可被度量。 然而，这种通用的点轨迹并未显式编码手与被操作物体的不同结构（Goswami 等，2025；Yuan 等，2026；Wang 等，2026；Xie 等，2026；Kim 等，2025）。 在物理性的手—物体交互中，手部关节通过运动学层级相互连接，而物体上的点则共享连贯的运动，并伴随由关节活动或形变引起的局部变化。 将这些关系保持为隐式（Sanchez-Gonzalez 等，2020；Pfaff 等，2021；Huang 等，2025），可能导致物体几何相对交互中的手发生扭曲或漂移，从而损害物理预测和后续的视觉合成。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we introduce DeXplicit ( Figure 1 ), a dexterous manipulation world model that explicitly predicts how the 3D world evolves before generating visual consequences. Our key idea is to separate physical state prediction from visual synthesis , rather than requiring a single heavy video model to implicitly learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, camera motion, and appearance generation altogether. 1) Explicit 3D state prediction. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, we predict the resulting geometric changes directly in metric 3D space using a lightweight dynamics network. By reasoning over object-centric motion and deformation, the model explicitly captures how hand actions transform the world state, providing geometrically grounded and directly interpretable future states. 2) 3D-guided video readout. Once the future 3D states are predicted, video generation becomes a substantially easier rendering problem rather than implicit world-dynamics prediction. We propagate appearance through the predicted 3D motion and use it as a strong visual and geometric scaffold for generation. This explicitly accounts for object motion and naturally incorporates viewpoint changes through 3D projection, allowing the video model to focus primarily on completing uncertain or newly visible content. Building on this decomposition, we employ a lightweight causal renderer that efficiently synthesizes temporally coherent consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出 DeXplicit（图 1），一个灵巧操作世界模型，它在生成视觉结果之前显式预测三维世界如何演化。 我们的核心思想是将物理状态预测与视觉合成分离，而不是要求单个庞大的视频模型隐式地同时学习动作条件的三维动力学、相机运动和外观生成。1) 显式三维状态预测。 给定初始场景和未来的手部轨迹，我们使用轻量级动力学网络直接在公制三维空间中预测由此产生的几何变化。 通过对以物体为中心的运动和形变进行推理，该模型显式捕捉手部动作如何改变世界状态，从而提供具备几何基础且可直接解释的未来状态。2) 三维引导的视频读出。 一旦预测出未来的三维状态，视频生成就变成了一个简单得多的渲染问题，而不再是隐式的世界动力学预测。 我们通过预测的三维运动传播外观，并将其作为生成过程中强大的视觉与几何支架。 这显式地考虑了物体运动，并通过三维投影自然地融入视角变化，使视频模型能够主要专注于补全不确定或新可见的内容。 基于这一分解，我们采用轻量级因果渲染器，高效地合成时间上连贯的结果。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DeXplicit on HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025a ) , covering rigid, articulated, and deformable interactions. Compared with PointWorld, DeXplicit reduces long-horizon moved-point error by 39.9 % 39.9\% , 28.0 % 28.0\% , and 27.1 % 27.1\% on the three datasets, respectively. These improvements also translate into more accurate object response in generated videos: under the same renderer, replacing PointWorld predictions with ours increases object IoU + from 0.373 to 0.549 on HOT3D. Our causal renderer also enables fast visual synthesis, generating 32 future frames in 4.90s on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU. Together, these results establish structured physical-state prediction as a key driver of interaction fidelity in dexterous world models, linking accurate action-induced object motion to faithful visual outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Particle and mesh simulators learn spatial interactions through graph networks ( Sanchez-Gonzalez and others, 2020 ; Pfaff and others, 2021 ) . ParticleFormer and particle-grid neural dynamics extend learned simulation to perceived objects and materials ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . PointWorld unifies scene and action trajectories in point space ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and PointZero learns transferable dynamics through track completion ( Duisterhof et al., 2026 ) . ObjectForesight predicts object poses from human video, while RigidFormer imposes coherent rigid motion ( Soraki et al., 2026 ; Dou et al., 2026 ) . Our shared object pose captures transport, and an embedded graph ( Sumner et al., 2007 ) expresses residual deformation, preserving coherence without restricting all objects to rigid motion.
paragraphs.zh: 粒子与网格模拟器通过图网络学习空间交互（Sanchez-Gonzalez and others, 2020；Pfaff and others, 2021）。 ParticleFormer 与粒子-网格神经动力学将学习式模拟扩展到感知到的物体与材质（Huang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025）。 PointWorld 在点空间中统一场景与动作轨迹（Huang et al., 2026），PointZero 通过轨迹补全学习可迁移的动力学（Duisterhof et al., 2026）。 ObjectForesight 从人类视频预测物体位姿，而 RigidFormer 施加连贯的刚体运动（Soraki et al., 2026；Dou et al., 2026）。 我们的共享物体位姿刻画搬运运动，嵌入图（Sumner et al., 2007）表达残余形变，在无需将所有物体限制为刚体运动的情况下保持连贯性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate one dynamics model across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025a ) , spanning rigid, articulated, and deformable interactions. We retrain PointWorld on the same forecasting task using the same initial metric scene points and 3D hand-joint trajectories through its native point-action interface. On HOT3D, video systems use their native controls. DeXplicit predicts future object geometry, as with PointWorld (Full protocols in Appendix A ). paragraphs.en: We presented DeXplicit , a dexterous manipulation world model built around a simple principle: predict how the world changes explicitly in 3D before synthesizing how those changes look. By separating structured metric dynamics from visual synthesis, our approach provides geometrically grounded future states while reducing the burden on the video generator to implicitly learn action-conditioned world dynamics. The predicted 3D states further provide a strong scaffold for efficient causal rendering, enabling coherent future observations with substantially reduced generation cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DeXplicit，一个围绕简单原则构建的灵巧操作世界模型：在合成这些变化的外观之前，先在三维空间中显式预测世界如何变化。 通过将结构化的度量动态与视觉合成相分离，我们的方法在提供具有几何依据的未来状态的同时，减轻了视频生成器隐式学习动作条件世界动态的负担。 预测的三维状态进一步为高效的因果渲染提供了强大支撑，能够在大幅降低生成成本的同时实现连贯的未来观测。

paragraphs.en: We retrain PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) on the same hand-object prediction setting. Its original action representation propagates robot-gripper surface points through a supplied joint trajectory using forward kinematics. We retain this point-action interface and substitute the supplied hand trajectories H ∈ ℝ T × N H × 3 H\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times N_{H}\times 3} . The baseline therefore receives the same metric action information through its original conditioning pathway. paragraphs.en: Each example contains one observed scene and a supplied 35-state action sequence, in which state 0 is context and states 1–34 are predicted jointly. The scene has at most 12,000 persistent points. Smaller clouds are padded and masked, while larger clouds are subsampled with consistent indices across time. Coordinates are expressed in meters without additional normalization. Only initial-state scene features enter the predictor. Precomputed pointwise DINO features and the initial geometric and appearance attributes are projected to width 256. Future object coordinates are supervision targets. The two hands retain 21 anatomical joints each. The joint encoder has four Transformer layers, width 256, four heads, feed-forward width 1,024, and dropout 0.1. The separate MANO-relative action encoder has two layers with the same width, head count, and dropout, using 15 pose coefficients and 10 shape coefficients per hand. Joint and action tokens are appended to the supplied hand-point tokens. Unavailable annotations are masked or zero-filled. Both absolute action states and backward differences are represented. For HOT3D, object membership follows the sampled object-mesh groups, and canonical coordinates are the corresponding object-local points. Legacy samples recover these coordinates using the inverse object pose at the context frame. MANO parameters are taken from the supplied hand annotations. These structured annotations are part of the declared input setting. PhysTwin provides sparse tracked hand-surface controls without reliable MANO joint identities. We retain these controls through the point-action interface.

paragraphs.en: The Point Transformer V3 ( Wu et al., 2024 ) uses the base encoder–decoder configuration in Table 9 . Scene and action tokens have width 256. Spatial serialization uses a 0.015 m grid and the Z, transposed-Z, Hilbert, and transposed-Hilbert orders, with order shuffling enabled. Every attention patch has 256 points, and stage transitions have stride 2. The MLP expansion ratio is 4, attention uses biased query, key, and value projections, pre-normalization, zero attention and projection dropout, and maximum stochastic-depth rate 0.3. Relative positional attention is disabled. A two-layer, four-head temporal action Transformer at width 256 follows the point backbone. Masked mean and max object pooling and canonical-coordinate embeddings supply an eight-layer object-time Transformer with width 256, eight heads, feed-forward width 1,024, GELU, pre-normalization, and dropout 0.1. The pose head uses hidden width 128 and outputs three translation and six rotation coordinates. The latter are orthonormalized into a proper rotation ( Zhou et al., 2019 ) . Dense displacement and log-variance heads also use hidden width 128 and predict all 34 future states.

paragraphs.en: We use K = 8 K=8 nodes per object, selected by deterministic farthest-point sampling of valid canonical points, starting from the point farthest from their centroid. Objects with fewer points use the available nodes and mask the remainder. Each point is connected to its four nearest nodes and each node to four neighboring nodes. Skinning weights are proportional to exp ( − ∥ c i − g k ∥ 2 / ( 2 r o 2 ) ) \exp(-\|c_{i}-g_{k}\|^{2}/(2r_{o}^{2})) and normalized over the selected nodes, where r o r_{o} is 1.5 times the median nearest-node spacing, lower-bounded by 0.005 m. The spatial deformation rank is four: we use the four lowest-frequency nonconstant eigenvectors of the symmetric, unnormalized graph Laplacian. Edge affinities are Gaussian, with scale given by the median graph-edge length. Eigenvector signs are fixed by their largest-magnitude entries.

paragraphs.en: Dense predictions provide votes for a differentiable proper-Kabsch global pose, and graph deformation supplies the local residual. Assigned object points are rendered through the resulting global pose and canonical graph, while unassigned points retain the dense path. The gauge projection transfers the best-fitting rigid component of the warp into the global pose without changing predicted positions. The carrier branch scores five candidates (current pose, left hand, right hand, both hands, and initial pose), masks unavailable candidates, and uses width-128 score and strength heads with zero-initialized strength. Pose corrections use the 0.05 m and 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} bounds specified below in Eq. 5 . Training uses BF16 autocast with FP32 parameters and optimizer states. Rigid fitting, graph composition, and gauge operations run in FP32 with autocast disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 稠密预测为可微的 proper-Kabsch 全局位姿提供投票，图变形提供局部残差。 被分配的物体点通过所得的全局位姿和规范图进行渲染，而未分配的点保留稠密路径。 规范投影将变形中最贴合的刚性分量转移到全局位姿中，而不改变预测的位置。 载体分支对五个候选（当前位姿、左手、右手、双手以及初始位姿）进行打分，屏蔽不可用的候选，并使用宽度为 128 的分数头和强度头，且强度头以零初始化。 位姿校正使用下文式 5 中规定的 0.05 米和 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} 的界限。 训练使用 BF16 自动混合精度，参数和优化器状态为 FP32。 刚性拟合、图组合和规范操作在关闭自动混合精度的情况下以 FP32 运行。

paragraphs.en: The hand branch combines 42 Gaussian joint heatmaps at 60 × 104 60\times 104 with a 642-dimensional per-frame vector. Each joint contributes current-camera and first-camera XYZ, wrist-relative XYZ, backward displacement, and three validity flags. A 12-value relative camera transform completes the vector. Four-frame packing yields nine temporal slots, repeating frame 0 for the initial group. The spatial encoder maps 168 channels through widths 128 and 1,536 with a 2 × 2 2\times 2 patch stride. The action MLP maps 2,568 inputs through width 256 to 1,536 and broadcasts spatially. Both output heads are zero-initialized.
paragraphs.zh: 手部分支将 42 个 60 × 104 60\times 104 的高斯关节热图与一个 642 维的逐帧向量组合起来。 每个关节贡献当前相机与首帧相机的 XYZ、相对手腕的 XYZ、反向位移以及三个有效性标志。 一个 12 值的相对相机变换补全该向量。 四帧打包产生九个时序槽位，初始组重复帧 0。 空间编码器以 2 × 2 2\times 2 的块步幅将 168 个通道映射至宽度 128 和 1,536。 动作 MLP 将 2,568 个输入经宽度 256 映射到 1,536，并在空间上广播。 两个输出头均以零初始化。

paragraphs.en: Persistent object points carry 16-channel VAE descriptors from the separately encoded initial image. Three temporal encoder stages of widths 256, 128, and 128 reduce 33 frames to nine slots, and a zero-initialized output supplies 96 VACE channels. The reference slot receives zero additional hand-conditioning or appearance-transport residual. The appearance-transport stream in Figure 3 uses one PCA basis and color range per sequence, with unsupported cells shown in black.

paragraphs.en: The conditional video discriminator follows the Wan1.3B architecture. A frozen 30-block video backbone provides features from blocks 13, 21, and 29. Three learned register tokens and three attention heads aggregate these features together with text context, the initial image latent, and rendered trajectory latents. A classifier maps the concatenated register features to one clip logit. The heads use width 1,536, feed-forward width 8,960, and 12 attention heads. paragraphs.en: The appearance encoder is similarly evaluated once per minibatch to create a detached, gradient-bearing feature leaf. Slot-wise replay accumulates the derivative with respect to that leaf, after which the small feature encoder is recomputed once per sample to propagate the accumulated gradient into its parameters. Recomputed features are checked for exact agreement with the cached forward. This retains gradients to the complete appearance-transport branch without storing its graph across all causal queries. Cached and replayed computations use the same precision. The BF16 autocast weight cache is disabled during replay to prevent reuse of detached parameter casts. Distributed workers complete their local causal replays before sample-weighted gradient synchronization, clipping, and the optimizer step.
paragraphs.zh: 外观编码器同样在每个小批量中仅评估一次，以创建一个分离的、携带梯度的特征叶子节点。 按槽位重放会累加对该叶子节点的导数，随后对每个样本重新计算一次小型特征编码器，以将累加的梯度传播到其参数中。 重新计算的特征会与缓存的前向结果进行严格一致性检查。 这样既保留了通往完整外观迁移分支的梯度，又无需在所有因果查询中存储其计算图。 缓存计算与重放计算使用相同的精度。 在重放期间禁用 BF16 自动混合精度权重缓存，以防止重复使用已分离的参数转换。 各分布式工作进程先完成各自的局部因果重放，再进行按样本加权的梯度同步、裁剪以及优化器更新步骤。

paragraphs.en: In the shorter-horizon HOT3D encoder study, moved-point L2 decreases from 44.6 mm without the action encoder to 42.4 mm with a joint Transformer and to 36.4 mm with additional MANO-relative action tokens. These results support preserving articulated hand structure in the action representation. The subsequent 35-state study compares the action-conditioned point baseline with structured object-centric SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) transport, an object-time Transformer, and auxiliary losses. Endpoint error on ever-moved points decreases from 122.76 to 87.45 mm, a 28.8% reduction for the structured configuration. The cumulative effect of the subsequent refinement components is evaluated in Table 4 .

paragraphs.en: The geometry ablation uses Wan2.2-TI2V-5B with equal training budgets and 150 evaluation windows from 75 clips. paragraphs.en: DeXplicit assumes an initial metric 3D scene and a future hand trajectory. Errors in these inputs may propagate into both physical-state prediction and video synthesis, and obtaining them reliably may require dedicated perception systems.

paragraphs.en: Appearance transport can only propagate features visible in the initial observation. Newly revealed or heavily occluded regions must therefore be synthesized by the renderer. Although the confidence-gated visual readout explicitly handles unsupported regions, large disocclusions can still reduce visual fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 外观迁移只能传播在初始观测中可见的特征。 因此，新显露或被严重遮挡的区域必须由渲染器来合成。 尽管经置信度门控的视觉读出机制明确处理了缺乏支持的区域，但大面积的去遮挡仍可能降低视觉保真度。
